# Frozen Stage 3 hypothesis contracts

Issue #1419; base `0e37653056be4389e806122b2f152c989d378622`.
The 64 manifest IDs and meanings were persisted before any novel exploratory
compilation. Calibration uses the three already-retained reduced #1412 sources;
it is excluded from novel discoveries and the exploratory source capacity.

| Suite | Shape 1 | Shape 2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R | Asymmetric number[] simultaneous cross-updates, complete snapshots and indexed consumers | Asymmetric point[] simultaneous cross-updates, complete coordinates and indexed consumers |
| N | Inner numeric final reaches outer next; empty inner and differing counts | Inner collection final reaches outer carry; escaped whole collection and indexed consumer |
| G | Root path carry selected stage/endpoint with alias consumer | Asymmetric sibling Module instances with deferred exported geometry/carry consumer |
| D | Selected/unselected lazy dependency within repeated numeric carry, adjacent selected-error contrast | Ancestor/Module computation gate, dependent consumer and independent error; ownership and suppression |

For all shapes, transform a alpha-renames owned declarations AND reorders
independent prerequisites/instances. Transform b replaces direct forwarding with
legal typed aliases and adds an independent prerequisite. Configurations 00/01/
02/03 target 0/1/2/4 iterations or selected occurrences where legal. Zero-iteration
cases retain initialization checks and separate selected/unselected controls.
Execute 00/01 first, assess boundary activation and fault yield, then execute
02/03. Values may be strengthened within these contracts; IDs cannot be replaced.

Novel domains exclude records, optionals and cross-document transport (#1194).
This finite slice leaves #1260 open with all remaining R1–R8 residual scope;
no whole residual or DSL-wide closure is claimed.
